short_release_notes:
Build 97 corrects the normal sender/node-agent event-ID contract. The outbound envelope uses the existing deterministic observation UUID shared with audio, while retained evidence and idempotency keys remain unchanged. Known legacy RTL adapter defaults are corrected from recorded KA9Q/RSP1B evidence.

Managed update only. Retains authority, physical provenance renewal, shared owner UI and native KA9Q capture. No RF or KA9Q changes.
